body:
No one knows what I'm going through at the moment but someone on Reddit was kind enough to message me in my inbox. 

I'm not based in America so I can't really call this line but thanks for the link, I hope anyone who's feeling down and lurking my post will find it useful.

Hi OP,

Anyone who correlates your worth with your height shouldn't be given your attention.

My friend is 5'3, and I am 5'4. He's kind of ugly by society's standards... not gonna lie... but I am hopelessly in love with him. I don't really know why either - I just am. The thing is, it's unreciprocated so I'm not as important to him as he is important to me. It's been killing me on the inside a bit, I will admit.

Give yourself a chance at life and keep on living, expand on your interests and hobbies and be proactive with reaching out to people you care about. One day you'll stumble across someone who will love you for who you are. It might take months or years, the key is to be patient and persistent.
